# CVGrid

> CVGrid is a free, AI-powered resume builder and career acceleration platform designed to help students, freshers, and experienced professionals create ATS-friendly resumes in minutes.

CVGrid pairs modern design aesthetics with strict Applicant Tracking System (ATS) compliance. It offers 18+ recruiter-approved resume templates, an AI content assistant for bullet points and summaries, a real-time ATS match scorer, an AI cover letter generator, and document conversion tools. Resumes can be downloaded in PDF, DOCX, and high-resolution PNG formats without watermarks.

## Core Capabilities & Features

- **Free AI Resume Builder**: Intuitive step-by-step editor with real-time PDF preview and intelligent content generation.
- **ATS Resume Checker & Scorer**: Upload or write resumes to calculate compatibility scores against target job descriptions and identify keyword gaps.
- **18+ Professional Templates**: Fully ATS-compliant templates categorized by industry (Classic, Modern, Executive, Developer, Minimalist, Elegant, Creative, and more).
- **AI Content Generator**: One-click professional bullet point rewriting, action verb optimization, and summary generation.
- **AI Cover Letter Builder**: Generates tailored, role-specific cover letters aligned with your resume experience and target company.
- **Career Tools**: Job description analyzer, interview question generator, portfolio creator, and resume sharing links.
- **Privacy & Security**: Built with client-side privacy safeguards, modern encryption, and secure cloud storage.

## Pricing & Transparency

- **Free Plan**: 100% free resume creation and watermark-free PDF downloads with core templates. No credit card required.
- **Premium Upgrade**: Tiny, one-time payment of ₹150 (~$1.80 USD) for lifetime access to all 18+ executive templates, DOCX export, and advanced AI tools. No recurring monthly subscriptions.

## Technical & ATS Compliance Details

All CVGrid templates are engineered according to top ATS vendor guidelines (Workday, Taleo, Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS):
- Clean text hierarchy using semantic headers (`H1`, `H2`, `H3`)
- Single and dual-column layouts tested against major ATS parsers
- Zero unreadable graphics, floating text boxes, or embedded tables
- High-contrast web-safe typography (Inter, Space Grotesk, Roboto, Arial)
- Standard ISO date formatting and scannable bullet points
- Vector-rendered PDF export with clean, selectable text layers
